script_text: Stop, Aquarius: Saturn and Uranus, your ruling planets, activate your Air element now! Jupiter is moving through your 7th House and opposing Pluto in your 1st House, intensifying partnerships, contracts, and public identity. The Moon in your 9th House trines Pluto and sextiles Saturn, sharpening insight and communication. For love, a taken relationship may expose an unspoken control issue, while a single Aquarius can attract a confident, ambitious partner through direct conversation. At work, use the 7th House to negotiate a client deal, but get every financial term in writing; your 10th House benefits from an alliance, not a rushed signature. Review budgets and shared expenses before committing; clarity protects your resources from costly, unnecessary future mistakes. Avoid power games, but expect an unexpected endorsement from someone influential. Follow for tomorrow's reading and catch the next transit before it lands.
